canonical_findings.evidence: Auto ALLOW can currently reach HANDOFF_COMMITTED without a decision-bound provenance record, and the Auto branch skips Skill source preflight.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Auto approval lacks a distinct versioned Host-owned saga transition compatible with genuine SDK effect and handoff evidence.

canonical_findings.evidence: The UI clears its Run projection before a backend acknowledgement, while the health endpoint does not query or mutate the durable SDK Run.
canonical_findings.root_cause: The cross-layer state machine lacks a versioned authoritative status projection and cancellation acknowledgement protocol.

canonical_findings.evidence: Stage-failure identity includes transient Run/call/effect IDs, so blind replay is not distinguished from an explicit retry generation.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Retry suppression lacks a stable source-input identity and one durable generation owner.

canonical_findings.evidence: Incremental testcases do not yet name exact receipt, Run version, query/cancel acknowledgement and timestamp oracles.
canonical_findings.root_cause: Acceptance expanded after the original oracle freeze without a corresponding low-level contract freeze.

decisions.rationale: Auto cannot reuse or fabricate a manual SDK decision. The plan must specify one versioned Host-owned auto-decision transition, common preflight, exact provenance, CAS replay and genuine effect/handoff evidence.
The durable SDK Run is authoritative. The plan must replace local-only timeout reset with versioned status query, explicit waiting projection and idempotent authoritative cancellation.
Stage failures need a source-input-derived identity and explicit retry generation so nonretryable replay does not repeat source work while a changed input remains a new request.
TC-GS-09 and TC-GS-10 must name the exact receipt, Run version, query/cancel acknowledgement and timing oracles before implementation.

plan_actions: Specify auto-approved-skill-install-v1 and its trusted saga transition without changing manual-v1.
Run the same source preflight in Auto and Manual before authorization diverges.
Specify stable stage-failure identity plus explicit retry generation.
Specify authoritative versioned Run status query and idempotent cancel acknowledgement ordering.
Freeze exact receipt, failure, waiting, cancellation and five-second UI settlement oracles.
